title: Cheesy Frittata
description: A simple, comforting breakfast dish made with eggs, cheese, and a hint of norwegian flavor.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add the shredded cheese and dried norwegian spice mix to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked onion in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the frittata is set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Slide the frittata out of the skillet onto a plate and serve hot.
